description: This file defines an Android Activity class named ViewGroupActivity, which is designed to display information about a view group. It sets the content view to a specific layout and updates a TextView with data from the intent.

classes.name: ViewGroupActivity
classes.description: An Android activity for displaying a view group, including a TextView that shows URI data from the intent.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Handles the activity creation, sets the layout, and initializes the TextView with data from the Intent.
